books.name: D · EMA20 sweep (15m trend · 5m levels · 1m entry · 2R) on top-5 volatile liquid HL perps · NO CAPS
books.desc: EMA SWEEP Nov 8 2026 (replaces the FIB limit entry and 1R TP for new D trades): Top-5 most volatile (mean 1h range, last 24h) of the 15 most liquid HL perps (24h notional), re-ranked hourly, BTC excluded. TREND = 15m EMA20/50 (close and EMA20 on the same side of EMA50, EMA50 sloping that way over 3 bars); longs only in a 15m uptrend, shorts only in a 15m downtrend, nothing when 15m is flat. LEVELS = 5m structure: 5m swing highs/lows (2-bar fractals, last 24h), 5m flipped levels (a 5m swing high and swing low within 0.1%, last 2d) and PDH/PDL. ENTRY = a closed 1m candle that SWEEPS the 1m EMA20: short - previous 1m close below its EMA20, this candle's high wicks above the EMA20 and it closes back below it, and the wick high reached within 0.15% of (or through) a 5m resistance level that the candle closes back below; long - the mirror (wick below EMA20, close back above, at a 5m support it closes back above). Market entry on the next 1m open (taker + 2bp + half the live spread). STOP = beyond the sweep wick and the 5m level, + max(0.05%, 0.2x 1m ATR); skipped if the stop is < 0.12% or > 1.2% from entry (size is always $0.75 risk). TP = 2R (maker limit at twice the stop distance). Skipped if expected net R to the 2R target after fees < 0.9. 30-min time stop, one entry per 5m level per session. NO CAPS (Nov 8 2026): no daily stop, no daily trade cap, no limit on open trades - it takes every setup the rules allow; only one open position per coin; weekly kill (-3R) still on. Entries any time (no session gate).
